name: wds_vtab-smallnorb_label_elevation
description: A vision classification task derived from the smallNORB dataset focusing on predicting object elevation (pose) labels from images. It measures a model's robustness to viewpoint/elevation changes and its ability to encode 3D pose information from 2D images, commonly used in VTAB-style evaluation suites.
reputation: Part of CLIP/VTAB benchmarking collections used to probe pose robustness and generalization of image encoders; known within the vision benchmarking community.
